description: Transliterate Persian, Dari or Arabic script into Latin letters, optionally as a URL slug. Use it to index Persian text in a Latin-keyword search engine, to build slugs for Persian titles, or to render Persian names in a Latin-only system. Returns the Latin transliteration and, when asked, the slug. ($0.01 per call, USDC on Base)

text.description: Persian (Farsi) text or value to process. Max 100000 characters.

name: fa_transliterate
